data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY 

Athletics Federation of India is organising the 10th Edition of New Delhi Marathon on 22.02.2026, carrying the message of Healthy Life under the FIT India Campaign and Clean Green Delhi / Swachh Bharat Initiative.

Approximately 13,000 participants will take part.

📍 Flag Off: Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium
📍Full Marathon (42.2 km) – 04:00 AM
📍Half Marathon (21.1 km) – 06:15 AM
📍10 KM Run – As scheduled

📍 TRAFFIC REGULATIONS & DIVERSIONS
-Traffic movement will be regulated from 03:45 AM to 09:30 AM on affected roads.
-Uninterrupted passage for emergency vehicles will be ensured.
-Diversions will be implemented at key junctions including Sewa Nagar Flyover, Kotla Red Light, Aurobindo Marg–Lodhi Road Junction, Neela Gumbad, C-Hexagon, Tilak Marg, Mathura Road and other connecting intersections as required.

📍Commuters are advised to avoid/bypass affected roads, use public transport and plan travel in advance, especially for ISBT/Railway Station/Airport journeys.

📍STAY UPDATED THROUGH DELHI TRAFFIC POLICE CHANNELS
